'''Ghia Preyssola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Preyssola worked for [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] and was responsible for forming and co-ordinating Republic Intelligence cells in the [[Luire system]]. Following the invasion of the Luire system by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Preyssola took refuge in the village [[Silence]] on [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the Luire system. She re-emerged when the Republic regained control of Nyriaan, and later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GoI" />
